Jordan: Heads-up: ZenLeaf sent a SIG/CAIQ and a short Q list. Deadline next Wed. Can someone own? <https://files.redwood.com/zenleaf/sig_zenleaf_v1.zip|SIG attached>

Jordan: One urgent question for the sales reply: Are embeddings stored outside the request lifecycle (e.g., in analytics DB)? Need approved wording.

Maya: I got it 1. Assigning to me. @security-requests-bot create ticket and cc privacy/legal.

security-requests-bot: Ticket RINF-2026-442 created. Priority P2. Assignee: Maya. Due: 2026-03-25.

Maya: Jordan, POC will be Hosted or Dedicated? That affects residency answer.

Jordan: Starting on Hosted for eval, but may shift to Dedicated. They require "no embeddings in analytics".

Arjun: For Hosted our standard: transient in-memory processing, no persistence of raw embeddings to analytics or long-term storage. We do keep non-content telemetry (latency, token counts). Recommend Dedicated/Private if they require customer-controlled persistence.

Arjun: Draft to use:
"We process and compute embeddings transiently during request handling. We do not persist raw embeddings to analytics or long-term storage for Hosted customers. For persistent, auditable storage, Dedicated or Private deployments can be configured."

Priya: Add legal caveat: "Except as required by law or a signed agreement (e.g., e-discovery)." Also note SOC/SIG mapping applied.

Maya: I'll incorporate those lines and validate control IDs in the SIG. ETA end of day tomorrow for the full response.

Jordan: Also include POC data deletion policy blurb for their legal: suggested 30 days after inactivity or on request.

Arjun: "POC datasets will be deleted on request and after 30 days of inactivity unless otherwise agreed in writing."

Priya: OK. Maya, flag any items needing an addendum.

Maya: Will do. I'll upload the completed SIG answers and the draft reply here after legal review.

security-requests-bot: RINF-2026-442 updated: status=In Progress, watchers=[Jordan,Maya,Priya,Arjun].
